dirList.profile: Santosh Kumar is a payments and financial services leader with more than 30 years of experience across Mastercard, Citi and Standard Chartered. He brings deep expertise in card payments, market development and government engagement across South Asia, having led Mastercard’s Sri Lanka and Maldives business and later its government partnerships across the region.

Martin Symes was Chief Marketing Officer of Sabre Travel Network Asia Pacific, where he led product development and content marketing for travel agencies and suppliers, as well as corporate and marketing communications.
Martin has more than 20 years of travel industry experience, starting with leading airlines and moving into the online travel space.
He was a key member of the team involved in bringing Priceline's buyer-driven e-commerce model to Asia. Martin then became the executive director, commercial at ZUJI, the Asia Pacific subsidiary of Travelocity.com. More recently, he was CEO of Wego.com, a leading travel metasearch engine.
Martin earned a master’s degree in Geography at Oxford University and gained an MBA from the London Business School.

Daniel has spent more than 15 years in investment management, working across public and private markets in Sri Lanka and Australia. His career has taken him from advisory and trading roles to building investment distribution networks and co-founding a venture capital firm.
Over the past decade, Daniel has advised private clients and managed investments in Sri Lanka, overseeing equity and private debt funds. He was also a founding partner of Hyperion Ventures, which helped pioneer venture debt in Sri Lanka.
Previously, Daniel was an Associate Business Development Manager at Pinnacle Investment Management in Australia. He helped expand Pinnacle’s institutional and retail distribution network, managing relationships with investment platforms, master trusts, custodians and research houses. During his time at Pinnacle, the firm’s assets under management grew from A$7 billion to A$50 billion over three years.
Earlier in his career, Daniel held advisory and trading roles at CommSec and John Keells Holdings. He holds a Bachelor of Economics from the University of Western Sydney and an MBA from Macquarie Graduate School of Management.

Mr. Abishek Sithampalam is a Sri Lankan entrepreneur and technology visionary with extensive experience in establishing, developing and scaling businesses, driving digital transformation and identifying strategic growth opportunities across diverse industry sectors.
He is the Co-Founder of findmyfare.com, one of Sri Lanka’s pioneering online travel agencies, which he has successfully grown into a multi-billion-rupee enterprise. Through this venture, he has demonstrated a strong ability to harness technology, build scalable digital platforms and transform traditional business models through innovation, operational excellence and customer-centric solutions.
 
He currently serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Knightsbridge Technologies, a software solutions company specializing in banking technology, where he provides leadership in driving technology-led business development and growth. He also serves as Chairman of Anantaya Resorts & Spa, a hospitality group with interests in the ownership and operation of two large-scale five-star hotels in Sri Lanka. These roles reflect his breadth of commercial experience and his involvement in developing and leading businesses across both technology-driven and asset-intensive industries.
Through his entrepreneurial ventures and leadership positions spanning digital commerce, financial technology and hospitality, Mr. Sithampalam brings to the Board a distinctive combination of strategic vision, entrepreneurial drive, commercial acumen and business leadership experience. His proven ability to identify opportunities, leverage technology, build scalable enterprises and drive business growth is expected to contribute valuable perspectives to the Board’s deliberations and support the Group’s strategic direction, future growth ambitions and the creation of sustainable long-term shareholder value.
